property_name: Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport
alt_price_sgd_note: Note 26 shows total consideration for H-REIT component (trust beneficial interest) = $56,881,000 SGD (Stapled Group, Note 26 p216). JPY 6,000 million purchase price per factsheet p30.
notes: Acquisition comprised: (1) trust beneficial interest of FPN acquired by Far East H-REIT through Nagoya Falcon TMK; (2) 100% shares in CENTRAIR hotel systems Ltd by Far East H-BT through FE Falcon Three Pte Ltd.
